items.html: Mudassar Bukhari is a promising allrounder who has represented the Netherlands A side several times before his call to the full squad in June 2007. Although he is able to boast Test batsmen like Taufeeq Umar and Mohammad Hafeez among his victims. Sometimes used as a pinch-hitter by his club, VVV, and country, his batting is better suited to the short form of the game so he is likely to come in at seven or eight in four-day matches. One of the highlights in his career was a Man-of-the-Match performance against Canada in the World Cup Qualifiers in South Africa, when he made 85.
